1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the non-native compartment is formed by the assembly of at least two different BMC polypeptides.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme that is distinct from the BMC polypeptide.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides, wherein the different BMC polypeptides are derived from at least two different bacterial species.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons, wherein at least one of the operons is distinct from the others.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product, wherein the product is a bioactive compound.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product, wherein the substrate is a metabolite of a biological pathway; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product. 

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments, wherein at least one of the compartments is distinct from the non-native compartment.
